audit_items.proof_trace: accrue_interest() correctly implements the ratio formula: it calls self.debt(new_borrow_index) at L55 (which computes amount * new_index / old_index via the debt() helper at L25) while self.borrow_index still holds the old value, then updates self.borrow_index at L56 only after the new amount is set. All callers (try_borrow_asset, repay_debt) invoke accrue_interest before any unsafe mutators, and the monotonic index assertion at L50 prevents negative interest.
